name: Chimamanda Okoro
bio:
Chimamanda Okoro is a seasoned agent known for her old-school approach and keen eye for talent, particularly in niche areas. Though she primarily represents actors and musicians, her late husband was a passionate Formula 1 engineer, fostering a deep respect for the dedication and skill required in motorsport. Chimamanda's cynical yet nurturing personality makes her a formidable negotiator, always prioritizing her clients' long-term well-being over short-term gains.

Her nostalgic view of the entertainment industry, coupled with her love for intellectual pursuits like philosophy and astronomy, makes her a unique figure in the fast-paced world of celebrity management. A racing driver might cross paths with Chimamanda through endorsement deals, media appearances, or perhaps even a connection to her late husband's network in the motorsport engineering world. She is hesitant to take on motorsport clients, preferring to focus on entertainment, but her genuine interest in the sport and her deep industry connections could be invaluable to the right driver.
